General Election - November 3, 2026
Vote Early, California!
The last day to register to vote online for November 3, 2026, General Election was October 19.  Eligible citizens who missed the deadline to register to vote may complete the "Same Day" voter registration process through Election Day on November 3, 2026, at their local county elections office or any in-person voting location within their county.
Make your voice heard, vote early! Return your ballot by mail as soon as you receive it. County elections officials will begin mailing ballots by October 5.
Ballots can be dropped off at a drop-off location, county elections office, or returned by mail. Secure ballot drop-off locations open by October 5.
Skip the lines on Election Day. The first vote centers opened for early in-person voting in all Voter’s Choice Act counties on October 24. In-person early voting locations throughout California will be open on Saturday, October 31.
To ensure your ballot is postmarked by Election Day make sure to mail it at least 7 days in advance. Mailed ballots must be postmarked on or before November 3.
If mailing a ballot on November 3, get a manual postmark from a postal employee inside a United States Post Office.
November 3 is the last day to vote in-person or return a ballot by 8:00 p.m. Polls are open from 7:00 a.m. to 8:00 p.m.
